final: SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS avg_patient_tat_difference FROM (SELECT AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS qualifying WHERE qualifying.ID = l.ID AND qualifying.`U-PRO` = '-' AND qualifying.RA = '-') GROUP BY l.ID)
